title: A Shifted Cohesive-Zone Method for Non-Interface-Fitted Meshes with Applications to Crystal Plasticity
summary: The accurate simulation of interface-dominated solid mechanics problems on complex microstructures remains challenging, particularly when interface-fitted quadrilateral or hexahedral meshes are difficult to generate. We extend the shifted boundary method (SBM) to cohesive-zone formulations and introduce the Shifted Cohesive Zone Method (SCZM), with applications to crystal plasticity on non-interface-fitted meshes.
